column3: With respect to the CVS-Walgreens Portfolio Mortgage Loan (3.5%), Walgreen Co., the sole tenant at the Walgreens Ellicott City Mortgaged Property, has a right of first refusal to purchase the Walgreens Ellicott City Mortgaged Property pursuant to the terms of its lease if the borrower receives an offer for the sale of the Walgreens Ellicott City Mortgaged Property that the borrower intends to accept. Upon receipt of notice from the borrower of such third-party offer, Walgreen Co. will have 20 days to exercise its right of first refusal to purchase the Walgreens Ellicott City Mortgaged Property at the price and on the terms of such third-party offer.
